definitions.explanation: an official government document certifying identity and citizenship for international travel

examples.japanese: {旅券|りょけん}を{更新|こうしん}する。
{旅券|りょけん}の{有効期間|ゆうこうきかん}は10{年|ねん}だ。
examples.english: The passport is valid for 10 years.

examples.japanese: {旅券|りょけん}を{紛失|ふんしつ}した{場合|ばあい}は{大使館|たいしかん}に{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: Please contact the embassy if you lose your passport.

notes:
FORMAL TERM:
{旅券|りょけん} is the formal/official Japanese term for passport. In everyday conversation, パスポート is more commonly used.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {旅券|りょけん}を{申請|しんせい}する (to apply for a passport)
- {旅券|りょけん}を{更新|こうしん}する (to renew a passport)
- {旅券|りょけん}を{紛失|ふんしつ}する (to lose a passport)
- {旅券番号|りょけんばんごう} (passport number)
- {旅券|りょけん}{発給|はっきゅう} (passport issuance)

JAPANESE PASSPORTS:
- 5{年|ねん}{用|よう} (5-year passport - navy blue cover)
- 10{年|ねん}{用|よう} (10-year passport - red cover)

OFFICIAL CONTEXTS:
{旅券|りょけん} is preferred in:
- Government documents and forms
- News reports
- Legal and formal contexts

RELATED WORDS:
- パスポート (passport - loanword)
- ビザ / {査証|さしょう} (visa)
- {身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ} (identification document)
